# What each query answers for a principal that is not the administrator.
#
# Written by go test -update. A line is a query that answered differently for
# the principal named in the section. An empty section means every query gave
# the administrator's answer, which is what a principal owning the objects
# ought to get.
#
# A section is <database>/<scene>/<principal>. The scene is the database the
# comparison ran in, because a contained user needs one of its own.

databases fewer rows than the administrator
foreign_servers refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.named_collections
index_columns refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.data_skipping_indices
indexes refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.data_skipping_indices
privileges refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.grants
role_grants refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.role_grants
roles refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.users
tablespaces refused: code: 497, message: dbmeta_parity: Not enough privileges. To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant SELECT ON system.storage_policies
